title: A density-uniform condensate bound for dilute Bose gases
main_claim: For a fixed bounded, nonnegative, radial, finite-range potential v (not a.e. zero) in 3D, there are rho_*(v), c_*(v)>0 such that for all 0<rho<rho_*, L>=L_0(rho), rho/2<=N/L^3<=2rho and 0<=T<=rho^2, the constant-orbital occupation <u_0,gamma^(1)u_0>/N >= c_*(v). This is proved by Cauchy-Schwarz a^2 <= q_0 * int f^2 dmu for a path-measure change nu built from cyclic reassignment of eligible bridges along random skeleton cell paths.
coverage: Read all sections (energy, localization, slab, atypical, defects, geometry, opening, comparison, conclusion) and checked them line by line. Energy and localization: Neumann cell bound (1)-(2) and its b^-3 scaling; entropy bound (3) via the ideal Bose grand partition function at fugacity e^-1; (4) and its error terms; F_j/j monotonicity from SSA concavity of S_i plus the pair-energy coefficient (j-1)/2 -> (j-2)/2; insertion bound (6), including the derivative/maximum of t log(C rho t^-3/2) on (0, rho^2]; two-colour localization (7) and the tilt identity (8); density tilts (9)-(11); occupation tails (12), including the k-particle addition isometry, the differential inequality for f(lambda), and the b_- and b_+ choices; isolation (13), including the deterministic bound a <= 2(n_chi-1)_+, the gradient cost C rho n_U0, and E_g Q <= C zeta^3 rho|S|. Slab: single-bridge lemma (p_*, C/sqrt r for the middle interval, the (16) anchor decay, mean score C K^2). Atypical trajectories: kernel bound (18) per bin; the marking-factor / gap bookkeeping e^{-2 kappa b_j}; Holder step (19); compression lambda_k(T) <= lambda_k(X); Lipschitz sandwich (20) via the form computation, exterior powers and weak log-majorization; W_0 <= (C/delta) sum eta_j 1_Omega_j; sector decomposition with gap M_j/2 >= rho + C rho; final error C_K(rho^{3/2}+rho^3). Defects: anchor packing (21) and B_0 = C(1+K^2/zeta^3); five-reason union bound with k' = eps b_- m u'/20 and the order zeta -> C_0; q_cl = C e^{-c lambda_0 m}; transfer (23) by Hilbert-Schmidt Cauchy-Schwarz, giving s^3 m/(NV) = 1/M^2. Geometry: |v_i| <= 1/2, |Z_t| <= w/4, at most 5 steps per level, k^{-3/2} conditional density from an unused dyadic block, nested-sum moment bound; fill nesting / non-adjacency, star-boundary connectivity, deletion invariance. Opening: mass q_0 for mu; density factor V^-1/(N^-1 s^-3) = m; displacement <= (D+10)s. Comparison: endpoint tables for C, O, C-hat, B; kernel ratio (28) is nontrivial only on d; start and end separation for j/l in O and in B; denominators (29) and (29a); stability (30), including the 2-changed-slots-per-cell slack, Delta_A against the count of changed nearby paths, and the R_* margin; path-list reconstruction (only whole unhit components are deleted) and (31); cellwise label sums (1+(e^C-1)/n_Q, e^C/n_a, [1+...]/n_b) giving C/m^2; recovery m/(m^2 M) = 1/N of mu_ab; defect test conversion (33); component exponential moment via rooted animal counting against S_{K_b}; 2 kappa_0 = alpha/5 + o(1) <= alpha. Parameter order in the conclusion is consistent (eps = alpha(D)/20 polynomial in D vs Gaussian decay in (17)). T=0 limit via the unique positive ground state. Taken on trust: standard facts (SSA, Sobolev-Poincare, Brownian bridge tails, Feynman-Kac normalization per Ueltschi).
